integrity.verification: Exact exhaustive finite coefficient enumeration, an independent maximal-fiber interpolation enumeration, rational projective-group orbit propagation, symbolic checks of all accepted smooth-orbit representatives, and direct F9-point computations.

scientific_limitations: Counts sections of O(2,3) over F3 up to scalar and the ruling-preserving ambient group PGL2(F3) x PGL2(F3), not abstract genus-two isomorphism classes.
No assertion for other fields, other bidegrees, or all degree-three maps on genus-two curves.
The genus-two F3 rational-point bound eight and its attainment were already established by Faber and Grantham; they are not claimed as new.
title: Extremal genus-two curves of bidegree \((2,3)\) over \(\mathbf F_3\): fifteen embedded types and three branch spectra
